_about: On-site simulation for the Policy-Corpus library (data/showcase/policies). Each question is what a staff member would type into Ask, with the date the as-of slider is set to. expect=answer: the answer must cite one of `cite` (clause@version) and mention every string in `mention`. expect=refuse: the answer must be the refusal sentence. Run: backend/tests/simulate_policy_corpus.py `documents`: files without front-matter, uploaded as plain documents with the given date and title. cite=[] accepts any citation.
